subject: Transportation Systems
title: The 15-Minute City
description: A fast breakdown of The 15-Minute City for builders.

hook.text: What if everything you need—work, school, groceries, parks—was within a 15-minute walk or bike ride?

buildup.text: The 15-minute city concept redesigns neighborhoods so daily needs are local, reducing car dependency.

discovery.text: Paris adopted the idea, converting parking into bike lanes and converting roads into pedestrian streets.

twist.text: Critics call it a restriction on freedom. Some conspiracy theorists claim it's a plan to trap people at home.

climax.text: The concept isn't new—traditional villages worked this way. Modern cities just forgot.

punchline.text: The 15-minute city is the ancient village, reimagined for today.

quiz.question: What is the core idea of the 15-minute city?
options: Essential services are within a 15-minute walk or bike ride
Cars must park within 15 minutes of destinations
